Business rules:
- RULE-001 [P0] Permitted account types for order payment: An order payment is only accepted for account types 'CTE', 'AHO' or 'VIR'. Any other account type is rejected with error 50001 and the message 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO'. (cites sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:34-37)
- RULE-002 [P0] Only pending orders can be paid: A payment order can only be processed if its status is 'P' (pending). If the order is in any other status, it is rejected with error 50003 and the message 'ORDEN NO ESTA PENDIENTE'. (cites sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:42-45, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:54-57)
- RULE-003 [P0] Payment requires an existing order: A payment cannot be processed for an order that does not exist. When the order lookup returns no rows, the procedure reports error 50002 with the message 'ORDEN NO EXISTE'. (cites sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:47-50)
- RULE-004 [P0] Company-specific service tariff with default fallback: The service tariff is taken from the company-specific tariff for the service, together with its 'charged separately' flag. If the company has no specific tariff, the service's default tariff applies and the commission is never charged separately ('N'). A missing tariff is treated as 0. (cites sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:62-66, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:68-68, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:70-72, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:76-77)
- RULE-005 [P0] Missing tariff defaults to zero: If no tariff value can be determined (NULL), the tariff is taken as 0, so no fee is charged. (cites sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:76-77)
- RULE-006 [P0] Commission by channel and NOMINA exemption: Payments made through the WEB channel pay half of the tariff as commission, rounded to 2 decimals. Other channels pay the full tariff. Service 'NOMINA' never pays a commission, whatever the channel. (cites sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:80-81, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:83-83, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:85-86)
- RULE-007 [P0] Amount debited depends on whether the commission is separate: If the tariff is marked as separate ('S'), only the order value is debited from the account. Otherwise the commission is added to the order value and both are debited together. (cites sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:89-90, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:92-92)
- RULE-008 [P0] Sufficient funds check with overdraft margin for non-VIR accounts: The payment is rejected with error 50004 'FONDOS INSUFICIENTES' when the balance does not cover the total. Accounts of type VIR must cover the total in full. All other account types may go 100.00 below zero. (cites sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:95-98, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:100-101, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:103-104)
- RULE-009 [P0] Order payment debits the account and fails on debit error: The total amount is debited from the customer's account with the reference 'PAGO ORDEN', and the movement sequence number is returned. If the debit fails, the payment ends with error 50005 'ERROR EN DEBITO'. (cites sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:110-115, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:117-117, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:120-121)
- RULE-010 [P0] Separately charged commission is debited from the payer account: When the commission is charged separately and is greater than zero, it is debited from the payer's account with reference 'COMISION PAGO'. If that debit fails, the operation reports error 50006 'ERROR EN COMISION'. (cites sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:126-126, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:128-132, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:134-134, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:137-138)
- RULE-011 [P0] Failed commission undoes the payment: If the commission processing returns a non-zero code (@w_return <> 0), the open transaction is rolled back and the error is set to 50006 with message 'ERROR EN COMISION'. (cites sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:134-138)
- RULE-012 [P0] Order payment recorded: state A, payment date and commission: When an order is paid, it moves to state 'A', the payment date is set to the process date and the calculated commission is stored on the order. (cites sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:144-149)
- RULE-013 [P0] Payment order update must affect at least one row: A payment is only treated as successful if the update of the order succeeded and touched at least one row. If the update fails or touches no rows, error 50007 'ERROR ACTUALIZANDO ORDEN' is raised. Otherwise the message 'PAGO REALIZADO' is returned. (cites sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:151-151, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:153-153, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:156-157, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:163-163)
- RULE-014 [P0] Order update failure or no order updated cancels the payment: If updating the order fails, or no order row is affected, the payment is rolled back and rejected with error 50007 'ERROR ACTUALIZANDO ORDEN'. A payment cannot succeed unless the order update took effect. (cites sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:153-157)
- RULE-015 [P0] Successful payment is committed as a single unit: At the end of the procedure, the transaction is committed and the output message is set to 'PAGO REALIZADO'. (Preconditions and rollback behaviour must be cited from the earlier lines that perform the debit, commission and order update.) (cites sp/sp_pago_orden.sp:161-163)

Graph nodes (id, kind, lines):
- proc:dbo.sp_pago_orden (StoredProcedure, sp/sp_pago_orden.sp, lines 6-171)
  Pays a pending payment order by debiting a customer account. It checks the account type, confirms the order exists and is pending, works out the commission from the company or general service tariff, and verifies available funds. It then debits the account through sp_debito, adds a separate commission debit when required, and marks the order paid in pg_orden. Any failure rolls back, sets an error code and message, and ends through sp_cerror; success returns 'PAGO REALIZADO'.
  - block:dbo.sp_pago_orden#B1 (block 'RF-01: only current, savings and virtual accounts can be debited', lines 20-39, phase pre)
    Validates that the account type is current (CTE), savings (AHO) or virtual (VIR). Any other type sets error 50001 'TIPO DE CUENTA NO PERMITIDO' and jumps to the ERROR block. Otherwise it continues to the order existence check.
  - block:dbo.sp_pago_orden#B2 (block 'RF-02: the order must exist and be pending', lines 41-59, phase pre)
    Reads the order's status from pg_orden using the order number and company. If no order is found it sets error 50002, and if the status is not 'P' (pending) it sets error 50003; both jump to the ERROR block. A valid pending order moves on to the tariff lookup.
  - block:dbo.sp_pago_orden#B3 (block 'RF-03: the tariff comes from the company table, else from the general service ta', lines 61-77, phase pre)
    Finds the service tariff and whether the commission is charged separately. It first looks in the company-specific tariff table (ad_tarifa_empresa); if nothing is found it uses the general service tariff (ad_servicio) with the separate flag set to 'N'. A missing tariff is treated as zero. Processing continues to the commission calculation.
  - block:dbo.sp_pago_orden#B4 (block 'RF-04: web orders pay half the tariff; payroll never pays commission', lines 79-92, phase pre)
    Calculates the commission from the tariff. Web orders pay half the tariff rounded to two decimals, other channels pay the full tariff, and the NOMINA (payroll) service always has zero commission. It also computes the total to debit: just the order value if the commission is separate, otherwise value plus commission. Continues to the funds check.
  - block:dbo.sp_pago_orden#B5 (block 'RF-06: virtual accounts cannot go below zero; other accounts may overdraw up to ', lines 94-106, phase pre)
    Reads the account balance from ct_cuenta by account number and type. Virtual accounts cannot go below zero, while other accounts may overdraw by up to 100.00. If the total exceeds what is available it sets error 50004 'FONDOS INSUFICIENTES' and jumps to ERROR; otherwise it proceeds to the transaction.
  - block:dbo.sp_pago_orden#B6 (block 'Statements 108-123', lines 108-123, phase transaction)
    Opens the transaction and calls sp_debito to debit the account for the total amount, with reference 'PAGO ORDEN', returning the movement number to the caller. If the call fails or reports an error, it rolls back, sets error 50005 'ERROR EN DEBITO' and jumps to ERROR. Otherwise it continues to the commission step.
  - block:dbo.sp_pago_orden#B7 (block 'RF-07: a separate commission is a second movement', lines 125-141, phase transaction)
    When the commission is charged separately and is greater than zero, it calls sp_debito a second time to debit the commission with reference 'COMISION PAGO'. A failure rolls back the transaction, sets error 50006 'ERROR EN COMISION' and jumps to ERROR. Otherwise it continues to the order update.
  - block:dbo.sp_pago_orden#B8 (block 'RF-08: the order is marked paid with the processing date and the commission char', lines 143-161, phase transaction)
    Updates the order in pg_orden to status 'A' (paid), storing the processing date and the commission charged. If the update errors or affects no rows, it rolls back, sets error 50007 'ERROR ACTUALIZANDO ORDEN' and jumps to ERROR. Otherwise it commits the transaction and moves on to the final block.
  - block:dbo.sp_pago_orden#B9 (block 'Statements 163-164', lines 163-164, phase post)
    Sets the output message to 'PAGO REALIZADO' and returns 0, signalling a successful payment. This is the normal end of the procedure.
  - block:dbo.sp_pago_orden#B10 (block 'ERROR', lines 166-171, phase error)
    Common error exit. It calls cobis..sp_cerror with the procedure name, the error number and the message set earlier, then returns the error code to the caller. All validation and failure paths in the procedure end here.
